name: Beijing Highlander Digital Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Highlander Digital Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of ocean observation and detection, smart ships, and navigation system in China and internationally. The company offers maritime products, including ship intelligent navigation system, composite radar system, engine room automation system, and ship-shore integrated communication system; and information service system solutions for ship intelligence for customers, such as ocean-going, coastal, inland waterway. It also provides offshore wind power and submarine data center collaborative technology. Beijing Highlander Digital Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
